    INSTRUMENTS

    SPECTROSCOPY & OPTICS

    01

    NanoBase customized
    confocal Raman microscope

    532 / 633 / 785 nm

    Customized confocal Raman system for Raman, SERS, optical imaging, and nanoscale spectroscopic measurements.

    02

    Home-built confocal
    Raman microscope

    488 / 532 / 633 / 785 nm

    Flexible home-built Raman platform for wavelength-dependent spectroscopy and customized optical experiments.

    03

    OceanOptics QEPro
    & NIRQuest Spectrometers

    Optical spectroscopy

    Fiber-coupled spectrometers for scattering, broadband optical spectroscopy, and visible-to-NIR spectral measurements.

    ELECTROCHEMISTRY & INTERFACE

    04

    Ivium Bipotentiostat

    Electrochemistry

    Electrochemical workstation for controlled potential and current measurements, including spectroelectrochemical experiments.

    05

    SRS QCM

    Quartz Crystal Microbalance

    Quartz crystal microbalance system for monitoring interfacial mass changes and surface reaction processes.

    FABRICATION & SAMPLE PREPARATION

    06

    Moorfield PVD
    Thermal Evaporator

    Thin-film deposition

    Physical vapor deposition system for preparation of metallic films and nanostructured substrates.

    07

    Plasol Plasma Cleaner

    Surface preparation

    Plasma treatment system for substrate cleaning, surface activation, and preparation prior to nanofabrication and spectroscopy.
